data.fund_type: An open ended equity linked saving scheme with a statutory lock in of 3 years and tax beneﬁt
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate long-term capital growth from a diversiﬁed portfolio of predominantlyequity and equity-related securities. There is no assurance that the objective of the Scheme will be realised and the Schemedoes not assure or guarantee any returns. For defensive considerations and/or managing liquidity, the Scheme may alsoinvest in money market instruments.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and equity related securities:80% TO 100% Debt* and Money market instruments.:0% TO 20% Units issued by REITs/InvITs:0% TO 10% *subject to ELSS Rules
